project.title: Hạt Sương Ban Mai — Đà Lạt Specialty Coffee TVC
project.logline: Từ giọt sương mai trên đồi cà phê Cầu Đất đến tách espresso bốc khói giữa lòng phố thị, đánh thức mọi giác quan.

continuity_bible.style_lock: Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with Cooke Panchro 50mm vintage prime lens, Kodak Vision3 250D warm natural film grain, shallow depth of field, rich espresso-brown and golden-amber cinematic color grade

ingredients.name: Minh — Nghệ nhân pha chế (Barista)
ingredients.short_anchor: the 29-year-old Vietnamese male barista in a dark olive linen apron
ingredients.invariant_description: A 29-year-old Vietnamese man with warm expressive dark eyes, neatly textured short black hair, natural skin pores, wearing a rolled-sleeve cream cotton henley shirt under a dark olive-green heavy linen barista apron

ingredients.name: Túi cà phê Hạt Sương & Tách Gốm Thủ Công
ingredients.short_anchor: the matte terracotta craft coffee bag and speckled stoneware espresso cup
ingredients.invariant_description: A minimalist matte terracotta-colored craft coffee pouch with embossed gold foil mountain emblem beside a handmade dark speckled ceramic espresso cup with thick golden-brown crema

shots.title: Giọt sương rơi trên trái cà phê chín đỏ
shots.director_note: Mở đầu bằng cú macro cực cận gây ấn tượng thị giác và âm thanh ASMR giọt sương rơi, kết nối thiên nhiên Đà Lạt.
shots.subject_state: A cluster of glossy deep-crimson ripe Arabica coffee cherries hanging on a wet green branch covered in crystal morning dew
shots.action: A single crystal dewdrop swells at the tip of a ripe red coffee cherry, trembles, and detaches in gentle slow motion
shots.secondary_physics: Tiny water ripples shimmer across the glossy cherry skin while cool white highland mist drifts softly through pine needles
shots.environment: Misty Cau Dat highland coffee plantation in Da Lat at dawn with layered pine hills blurred in the background
shots.lighting: Low-angle golden sunrise rim light piercing cool blue morning mist, creating luminous specular highlights inside the falling droplet
shots.last_frame_state: Extreme macro close-up of the ripe red coffee cherry glistening right after the droplet falls, golden sunbeam flaring warmly across the branch
shots.transition_out: Match cut on falling drop to pouring espresso stream

audio.sfx: Crisp resonant water droplet chime, gentle highland morning breeze rustling leaves
audio.music: Single warm acoustic cello harmonic note fading in

shots.title: Dòng chảy Espresso vàng óng
shots.director_note: Nối nhịp chuyển động từ giọt sương sang dòng chiết xuất cà phê đặc sánh rơi vào tách gốm thủ công.
shots.subject_state: Bottomless brass espresso portafilter suspended directly above the handmade dark speckled ceramic cup on a brushed steel drip tray
shots.action: Rich velvety tiger-striped espresso streams coalesce into a single syrupy golden-brown ribbon pouring steadily into the ceramic cup
shots.secondary_physics: Thick hazelnut-colored crema swirls at the surface while delicate aromatic white steam curls upward into the light
shots.environment: Warm wooden specialty coffee bar counter with soft-focus copper coffee equipment in the background
shots.lighting: Warm directional tungsten sidelight illuminating the translucent amber crema and rising steam against dark moody wood
shots.transition_out: Cut on steam rising toward barista's face

audio.sfx: Rich velvety espresso extraction purr, gentle liquid stream pattering into thick crema
audio.music: Warm fingerstyle acoustic guitar pulse enters softly

shots.title: Khoảnh khắc trao hương vị
shots.director_note: Nhân vật chính xuất hiện đồng nhất với @Image1, tương tác tự nhiên và thoại lip-sync tiếng Việt ngắn gọn, ấm áp.
shots.camera_move: Slow Steadicam push-in at eye level
shots.subject_state: Minh stands behind the walnut coffee bar holding the steaming speckled ceramic espresso cup gently with both hands
shots.action: He places the steaming espresso cup onto a wooden coaster toward the viewer, looks up with a genuine warm smile, and speaks naturally
shots.secondary_physics: Delicate wisps of coffee steam drift past his linen apron as floating dust motes dance in the morning sunbeams
shots.environment: Sunlit artisan wood-and-glass cafe interior with lush green indoor ferns softly blurred behind him
shots.lighting: Soft golden morning window key light from the left with warm natural skin tones and gentle shadow roll-off

audio.sfx: Soft ceramic cup resting on wooden coaster, quiet cozy cafe room tone
audio.dialogue: Một ngụm sương mai Đà Lạt, trọn vẹn cho ngày mới.
audio.music: Warm acoustic guitar and soft upright bass swell

shots.title: Hero Packshot — Hạt Sương Ban Mai
shots.director_note: Khung hình tĩnh sang trọng chừa khoảng trống (negative space) bên phải để hậu kỳ chèn slogan & logo thương hiệu.
shots.framing: Medium tabletop product hero shot with clean negative space on the right third
shots.subject_state: The matte terracotta coffee pouch stands on the left two-thirds of a rustic dark walnut table beside the steaming ceramic espresso cup and scattered roasted coffee beans
shots.action: Camera glides subtly sideways as golden sunlight slowly sweeps across the embossed foil emblem on the pouch
shots.secondary_physics: Gentle aromatic steam rises continuously from the espresso cup while tree-leaf shadows dapple softly across the wood grain
shots.environment: Open wooden terrace overlooking misty green highland hills blurred softly in the distance
shots.lighting: Radiant golden hour sunlight with crisp rim highlights along the pouch edges and warm creamy bokeh

audio.sfx: Soft morning breeze, subtle porcelain warmth
audio.music: Resonant warm acoustic guitar chord resolving cleanly
